subject.title: fix(cli): bound --message-file reads for agent command

question: Should `openclaw agent --message-file` adopt an unconditional, documented 4 MiB ceiling even though previously accepted larger files will stop working?
rationale: The implementation safely fixes the unbounded read, but source and tests cannot choose the permanent public size threshold or authorize the resulting compatibility break.

options.title: Confirm the 4 MiB ceiling
options.body: Accept the documented compatibility change and merge the current bounded implementation once exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Choose another fixed ceiling
options.body: Set a maintainer-approved constant before merge while retaining the same bounded descriptor-read and compatibility-preservation design.

recommendation.title: Confirm the 4 MiB ceiling
recommendation.body: Accept the documented compatibility change and merge the current bounded implementation once exact-head checks complete.
